booking.instructions: Call (817) 261-4333 to schedule, or leave your details here and we'll follow up by email.

demo_chips: How much does a consultation cost?
How do I book a consultation?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can reach Beal Law Firm, PLLC at (817) 261-4333 or lawyers@dfwdivorce.com, or leave your name and email here and we'll follow up.

faqs.q: Is there a cost to call the office just to see if you can help me?
faqs.a: No - call or write to us anytime for a free evaluation.

faqs.q: Why is there a fee for an initial consultation?
faqs.a: Our consultations are with licensed attorneys, last an hour or more, and are not a sales pitch - you leave with real legal guidance on your situation.

faqs.q: Do you offer after-hours or weekend consultations?
faqs.a: Yes - including early mornings, evenings, nights and weekends by arrangement. Payment is required at booking and a small additional charge may apply.
